title: UAE's Cargo Line completes investment deal with global Alonso Group to expand regional business
summary: Alonso Group makes a significant strategic investment in Dubai-based Cargo Line Freight and Logistics, strengthening its presence in the Middle East. Image Courtesy: Cargo Line

contentHtml:
Alonso Group makes a significant strategic investment in Dubai-based Cargo Line Freight and Logistics, strengthening its presence in the Middle East. Image Courtesy: Cargo Line

Press Release

Dubai, UAE: UAE-based Cargo Line Freight and Logistics has concluded a transaction with Alonso, a global company headquartered in Spain with operations spanning five continents, under which the group has acquired a significant strategic stake in Cargo Line to support its expansion across the Middle East. 

The investment gives Cargo Line access to Alonso Group’s international freight forwarding network, procurement capabilities and operational resources, creating opportunities to strengthen its existing operations and expand its regional reach. 

Founded in 2004, Cargo Line specialises in freight forwarding and logistics services for international luxury fashion brands and major solar energy companies. Its operations include time-sensitive shipments between European fashion centres and Middle Eastern markets, as well as logistics support for solar infrastructure projects in remote locations.  

The company was named SME of the Year at the Logistics Middle East Awards 2026. 

Expansion plans 

The partnership is expected to support Cargo Line's plans to strengthen existing operations and expand its regional reach. 

Alonso Group's international network, which includes freight forwarding, port terminals, rail and road transport, and warehousing, provides Cargo Line with greater access to overseas markets and logistics infrastructure. 

Cargo Line will continue under its existing leadership, with Niranjan Venkatesh remaining CEO and Nasser Chhipa continuing as Director. 

Niranjan Venkatesh, CEO of Cargo Line, said: "Cargo Line's reputation has been built by people who learned, grew and took responsibility for getting difficult things done. They have earned our customers' trust through the care they bring to their work. With Alonso holding, we have the opportunity to build on that foundation and do more for our customers." 

Pedro Lopez, CEO of Alonso Forwarding, said: "Cargo Line has earned the trust of customers whose projects demand care, expertise and accountability. We see clear synergies in combining the knowledge and relationships its people have built with our international network and resources. Together, we have a strong opportunity to expand our presence across the Middle East, serve customers better and pursue new opportunities for growth." 

International backing 

Alonso Group reported turnover of €1.94 billion in 2025 across its logistics, energy and infrastructure, and leisure and hospitality businesses. 

Its logistics division generated €1.58 billion in revenue and handled more than 410,000 twenty-foot equivalent units (TEUs). Alonso Forwarding ranked 41st globally by TEU volume in the 2025 Transport Topics the leading international rankings. 

The completed transaction gives Cargo Line access to a larger international logistics network while allowing it to retain its existing management and customer relationships. 

This transaction reinforces Alonso Group's strategic commitment to the Middle East, a region with significant growth potential, and reflects its intention to continue exploring new opportunities for collaboration and business development alongside local partners.

About Cargo Line Freight and Logistics 

Founded in Dubai in 2004, Cargo Line Freight and Logistics provides freight forwarding and specialised logistics services to international customers, including luxury fashion brands and solar energy companies. 

The company manages time-critical shipments and project logistics across the Gulf markets and employs 45 people. 

Website: www.CargolineFL.com 

About Alonso Group 

Headquartered in Spain, Alonso Group is a multinational group with interests in logistics, energy and infrastructure, and leisure and hospitality. 

The group recorded €1.94 billion in turnover in 2025, including €1.58 billion from its logistics division. Its logistics operations span international freight forwarding, port terminals, rail and road transport, warehousing and last mile. 

Website: www.alonsoforwarding.com
